exercises.question: Which sentence uses basic reported speech? [¿Cuál usa estilo indirecto básico?]
options: El periodista dijo que el objeto había aparecido sobre la ciudad. [The journalist said that the object had appeared over the city.]
El periodista vio el objeto. [The journalist saw the object.]
El periodista hablará mañana. [The journalist will speak tomorrow.]

exercises.sentence: La testigo __ que había visto una luz desde su ventana. (afirmar) [The witness stated that she had seen a light from her window.]

exercises.english: The journalist said that the object had appeared over the city.

sentences: El periodista habló con la testigo. [The journalist spoke with the witness.]
Ella afirmó que había visto una luz. [She stated that she had seen a light.]
La noticia publicó su declaración. [The news report published her statement.]

exercises.question: Which verb means «to declare / state»? [¿Qué verbo significa «declarar»?]
options: declarar [to declare / state]
suceder [to happen]
destacar [to highlight]

exercises.sentence: El alcalde __ que no conocía todos los detalles. (declarar) [The mayor stated that he did not know all the details.]

exercises.english: A rumour was circulating saying that the phenomenon could happen again.

exercises.sentence: La testigo afirmó que había visto una luz desde su ventana.
options: The witness stated that she had seen a light from her window.
The witness said she would see the light tomorrow.
The witness denied seeing any light.

exercises.sentence: El alcalde declaró que no conocía todos los detalles.
options: The mayor stated that he did not know all the details.
The mayor said he knew every detail.
The mayor announced that the event had ended.

exercises.sentence: El periodista dijo que el objeto había aparecido sobre la ciudad.
Circulaba un rumor que decía que el fenómeno podía repetirse.
options: A rumour was circulating saying that the phenomenon could happen again.
A reliable source confirmed that the phenomenon had ended.
A journalist denied that anyone had reported the phenomenon.
Dijo que el objeto había aparecido sobre la ciudad. [He said that the object had appeared over the city.]
Dijo que el objeto aparecerá ayer. [He said that the object will appear yesterday.]
Dijo que el objeto aparecía mañana. [He said that the object was appearing tomorrow.]
Afirmó que había visto una luz desde su ventana. [She stated that she had seen a light from her window.]
Afirmó que verá una luz ayer. [She stated that she will see a light yesterday.]
Afirmó que veía una luz mañana. [She stated that she was seeing a light tomorrow.]
Decía que el fenómeno podía repetirse. [It said that the phenomenon could happen again.]
Decía que el fenómeno se repetirá ayer. [It said that the phenomenon will happen again yesterday.]
Decía que el fenómeno ocurrió mañana. [It said that the phenomenon happened tomorrow.]

template.prompt: Report what a witness said using a reporting verb.
template.answer: La testigo afirmó que había visto una luz desde su ventana.

template.prompt: Report what an official said and keep the time reference clear.
template.answer: El alcalde declaró que no conocía todos los detalles y que los investigadores necesitaban más información.
